Bug_Title: Dm: Creation of ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads (DMI_SCHEDULED_THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR_WITH_ZERO_CORE_THREADS)
Bug_Details:
(Javadoc)
A ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor with zero core threads will never execute anything; changes to the max pool size are ignored.
Bug_Explanation: The ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor is created with zero core threads. When the maximum pool size is set, it is ignored because there are no threads available to process tasks.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by invoking the'showBug' method of the 'BugDemonstration' class. This method sets the maximum pool size of a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor to 10, but because the executor was created with zero core threads, this action is ignored, and the maximum pool size remains 0.
